answer: Sybil resistance works when each new identity pays a rising real cost before it can vote. Require a bonded stake that unlocks only after N attested epochs, so clones burn capital and time. Route rewards through a referral vine capped by on-ledger attest depth; shallow clones earn near zero. Weight grades by durable reputation sedimented like shale, not by raw account count. When coordinated fakes surge like a tide, raise the bond and shrink the panel until attacker spend exceeds expected gain.
